title: Optocam Zero: a Pi Zero based digital camera made using off the shelf components
summary: Optocam Zero is a DIY digital camera project built using Raspberry Pi Zero and readily available off-the-shelf components, creating a fully functional camera from accessible parts.
problem_solved: Provides an affordable, educational way for makers to build their own digital camera while learning about hardware-software integration.
why_valuable: Makes camera technology accessible and understandable through hands-on construction, demonstrating that complex devices can be built from simple components.
